Job description for Offshore Planner position

Reports To: Offshore Maintenance Superintendent (hierarchically)
Onshore Planning Lead (functionally)


Background: This position will be responsible for the look ahead and ensuring that all planned and corrective maintenance is effectively scheduled to meet requirements considering the activities in the asset plan and associated vendor requirements. They are the owner of 14 and 28 days look ahead.
Accountable For: Typical Responsibilities & Standards

1) Develop And Maintain Effective Working Relationships
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and visitors to the working environment.
Establish and maintain effective communications with colleagues, external visitors and supervisors.
Carry out accurate and effective work handovers.
2) Implementation of Management System
Ensure compliance with applicable IOP planning and CMMS procedure.
Liaise, prepare and update Unit weekly planning and scheduling activities.
Conduct weekly Planning meetings with offshore HOD’s and onshore IOP planner to freeze 14 days look ahead schedule.
Ensure any conflict in respect to SIMOPS, resources and materials are highlighted to the relevant parties.
Ensure in conjunction with all HOD’s that all assurance activities are carried out on the schedule and comply with unit’s verification scheme.
Responsible for reviewing & prioritizing all corrective work requests with the work team to ensure corrective work order priorities are properly assigned.
3) Control of Works
Offshore owner of 14 and 28 days plan lookahead, ensuring that all planned and corrective maintenance is effectively scheduled to meet requirements considering the activities in the asset plan and associated vendor requirements.
Monitor weekly execution progress
When required develop work plans for maintenance jobs with necessary information to allow efficient scheduling, assignment, and execution of maintenance work.
Perform site readiness check and validate the appropriate job work scope with the offshore disciplines and feedback to onshore unit planner.
Monitor Maintenance KPIs and performances, warn support team of any recurring problems related to the maintenance activity back log.
Suggests improvements and requests modifications for planning and for the CMMS and Work Order flow chart.
4) Management of Conditions, Behaviours and Events
Contribute to the continued improvement and implementation of the best practices in the planning discipline.
Review CMMS reporting are done efficiently and correctly. Equally, help with CMMS activities such as correction of Notifications, upload activities report under CMMS, and so on.

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience
Degree in relevant technical or business discipline or can be substituted by suitable industry experience.
Extensive experience as a maintenance planner or Supervisor in oil and gas upstream industries.
A basic knowledge of the process of oil and gas treatment, installations and a thorough knowledge of the equipment used in oil and gas treatment installations.
Experience in Planning software (primavera P6) and CMMS (IFS) and electronic Permit-to-Work systems.
Proficiency in English at a minimum of B1 level according to the CEFR international standard.

description:
Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Centro Especializado de Estímulo ao Desenvolvimento Infantil - Reabilitação Intelectual e TEA (CEEDI) é um serviço cuja proposta é rever e transformar a lógica do capacitismo e oportunizar o diagnóstico qualificado em tempo oportuno, por meio de um modelo de serviço que incorpore a avaliação especializada para o diagnóstico diferencial, estimulação precoce, com equipe multidisciplinar para processo de re/habilitação, envolvendo a rede de apoio no processo e projeto terapêutico.

Trata-se de um centro de reabilitação, modalidade reabilitação intelectual, com ações e serviços voltados para avaliar, desenvolver ou ampliar a capacidade funcional para o desenvolvimento pleno das crianças e adolescentes com deficiência intelectual, transtornos globais de desenvolvimento, transtorno do espectro autista, investindo em iniciativas que trabalhem potencialidades, talentos, habilidades e aptidões físicas, cognitivas, sensoriais, psicossociais, atitudinais, profissionais e artísticas, para a autonomia e participação cidadã em igualdade de condições e oportunidades com as demais pessoas. A habilitação/reabilitação prevê uma abordagem interdisciplinar e o envolvimento direto de profissionais, cuidadores e familiares/ parceiros nos processos de cuidado.

O profissional, terá a função de realizar o seguimento das crianças com alterações nos marcos do desenvolvimento, contemplando a avaliação longitudinal com o objetivo de elucidação diagnóstica, início precoce da estimulação precoce e orientação dos familiares e responsáveis.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina com registro ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Registro de especialista em Psiquiatria (RQE)
  • Desejável pós-graduação em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Saúde Mental; TEA; Saúde da Família; Saúde Pública; Saúde Coletiva
  • Registro ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Desejável experiência com TEA (Transtorno do Espectro Autista na infância e adolescência)

Additional information

  • Carga Horária: 40h/20h semanais
  • Local de atuação: AP 3.3 (Madureira e Adjacências)

title: Oficial de Eletricista I
description:
Veja mais vagas e encontre uma nova oportunidade.

Responsabilidades

  • Executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de instalações, inspecionando sistemas elétricos, efetuando a troca de lâmpadas, luminárias e reatores, verificando o estado de interruptores, tomadas e condutores, passando cabos por conduletes, instalando eletrocalhas, eletrodutos e dutos subterrâneos e realizando outras atividades, visando o atendimento às necessidades do Contrato.
  • Executar a manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos (aparelhos e equipamentos hospitalares, Back Lights, Postes de Iluminação, Boilers, Bombas hidráulicas, Tele Tubos, máquinas de lavar louça, cafeteiras, liquidificadores, fornos, etc.), lubrificando peças e trocando circuitos, comandos e motores, a fim de possibilitar o pleno funcionamento da infraestrutura do Contrato.
  • Executar a manutenção preventiva de quadros elétricos de baixa tensão, isolando ferramentas, reapertando e trocando disjuntores e borneiras de circuitos, instalando contactores, verificando condições de fios e cabos, efetuando medições de tensão e corrente elétrica através de aparelho Multiteste, limpando componentes com a utilização de produtos químicos específicos e realizando outras atividades, visando o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos, instalações e infraestrutura do Contrato.
  • Realizar operações em linhas de alta tensão no caso de queda de energia e mediante autorização da Light, efetuando manobras e transferências de ramais de acordo com os equipamentos e procedimentos de segurança requeridos, a fim de possibilitar a religação da força necessária ao atendimento das necessidades do Contrato.
  • Executar a manutenção preventiva de No Break, efetuando a leitura de parâmetros e a medição de corrente elétrica, reapertando peças, limpando componentes e trocando baterias, a fim de manter as condições de operacionalidade requeridas.
  • Executar a manutenção preventiva de subestações, limpando componentes, reapertando e lubrificando peças, medindo a voltagem de baterias, trocando fusíveis, verificando o funcionamento de quadro de capacitores, nível de óleo combustível e lubrificante de motores e estado de conservação de correntes e mangueiras, bem como inspecionando ruídos, aquecimentos e outras anormalidades, a fim de propiciar o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos e infraestrutura do Contrato.
  • Operar subestações no caso de falta de energia elétrica, acompanhando a ligação automática do equipamento e desligando o gerador no restabelecimento da força, visando o pleno fornecimento de energia para máquinas e instalações do Contrato.
  • Efetuar a manutenção preventiva de transformadores, reapertando e lubrificando peças.
  • Efetuar a leitura de plantas, desenhos e diagramas elétricos.
  • Emitir formulário específico (Laudo), detalhando tipos de problemas, setores, equipamentos e outras informações referentes aos serviços executados, para fins de controle e informação à Chefia.
  • Efetuar anotações em Livro de Ocorrências, indicando os eventos ocorridos, serviços executados, horários, datas e outras informações pertinentes, a fim de possibilitar o controle dos serviços de manutenção.
  • Atuar em outras especialidades de manutenção elétrica conforme a necessidade.
  • Orientar os demais profissionais da equipe, dirimindo dúvidas e indicando procedimentos, a fim de agilizar os trabalhos de manutenção.
  • Manobra com subestação, conhecimento em acionamentos elétricos (soft start e inversor), conhecimento de motores elétricos, comandos elétricos, iluminação em geral, instalação elétrica de baixa tensão em geral.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Rio de Janeiro, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local;Educação para o consumo consciente de energia.

Divulgar os projetos, apoiando em atividades e eventos externos;

  • General upkeep
  • Guidelines and Policies related to Administrative and Financial Matter

Pending criminal cases against children may be grounds for disqualification; those proven to have violated laws protecting children (e.g., RA 7610) will automatically be disqualified for the position.

Application with incomplete documents shall not be entertained and only shortlisted applicants will be notified.

Equal Employment Opportunity Principle

All vacant positions shall be open to all qualified applicants regardless of age, gender, civil status, disability, religion, ethnicity, social status, class, political affiliation, or other factors which run counter to merit and fitness for the job and equal employment opportunity.

Background

  • The Production Technician is responsible for operating plant process and utility systems effectively and safely, always ensuring strict adherence to procedures. Compliance with GEMS and local regulatory requirements must be maintained in all aspects of work.
  • The Production Technician is also responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside flanges and bolts. The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The production technician will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

Authority

  • The Production Technician is authorized to operate the process and utility systems safely and efficiently and help to prepare such plant for maintenance.
  • Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendors, external and unplanned or temporary services.

  • 1

  • 3 Ensure sampling is carried out and sample results are acted upon.
  • 4 Trouble shoot to maximize sales quality and delivery volume to identify problems.
  • 5 Maintain discharge water quality within current O &M Contractor or local guidelines.
  • 6 Monitor and operate electrical/hydraulic control panels, safety and emergency shutdown devices, Fire and Gas Systems.
  • 7 Ensure accurate and timely production reporting and logging is submitted daily or as required by company.
  • 8 Witness third party calibrations when appropriate to provide verification of meter factors and volumes.
  • 9 Prove export oil meters.

  • 1 Work as directed by Management System policies and procedures in particular Isolation Standards, and PTW.
  • 2 Carry out all operations in safe and environmentally sound manner.

  • 4 Ensure vendor and subcontract personnel within responsibility understand and comply with current environmental regulations.
  • 5 Carry out Emergency Response role.
  • 3) Maintenance
  • 1 Facilitate maintenance operations by applying/removing isolations as required.
  • 2 Operation under PTW system, Toolbox Talk and Risk Assessments.
  • 3 Advise maintenance personnel on hazards of plant and equipment.
  • 4 Facilitate maintenance operations related to preservation when required.

  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role.

description:
Join to apply for the Interpretation Geophysicist role at Viridien .

Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt).
  • Create local velocity scenarios.
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps).
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights.
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.

About The Team

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private Pension Plan
  • Meal Voucher
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu Therapy at the Office
  • TotalPass Fitness Program
  • Hybrid Work Model (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Birthday Day Off
  • Christmas Gift Card
  • Educational Assistance and Language Learning Programs
  • Continuous training via the Learning Hub, with both technical and behavioral courses.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. We may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant due to high application volumes. Candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview, and we aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round and beyond. If you require any reasonable adjustments to participate in the application or interview stages, please contact your recruiter directly. We value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

About Lumx

Lumx is building the stablecoin payments stack for Latin America and beyond—API-first on/off-ramps, virtual/external accounts, wallets, and compliant FX. We deliver instant settlements and institutional-grade reliability. Backed by leading partners (including BTG Pactual), we combine product excellence with security and compliance.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with advanced experience in fintech, payments, and FX to design, build, and operate existing mission-critical services that power pay-ins, pay-outs, and currency conversion (quoting, rate locks, execution, settlement). You’ll work across API design, event-driven systems, and function-orchestrated workflows, always with reliability, observability, recoverability and idempotency as first-class requirements.

What You’ll Do

  • Integrate partners fast: Ship high-quality connectors with banks, PSPs, and FX providers.
  • Own core money flows: Design and run services for pay-ins/pay-outs/FX (quoting, rate-lock, execution, netting, and settlement).
  • Raise reliability bars: Implement robust idempotency, retries/backoff, DLQs, and graceful degradation.
  • Build event-driven workflows: Orchestrate function-based workflows and long-running sagas for multi-party financial processes.
  • Model money correctly: Ensure reconciliation across entities and precise amount/rounding semantics.
  • Document & mentor: Write clear ADRs/runbooks and help level up the team through code reviews and sharing your technical knowledge.

What you bring

  • 5+ years building backend services at scale (fintech/payments/FX experience required).
  • Strong TypeScript + Node.js fundamentals; clean modular design and high-quality APIs (REST/JSON).
  • Deep understanding of event-driven architectures (queues/streams), saga patterns, and function-orchestrated flows (experience with Temporal.io is a plus).
  • Solid data fundamentals: relational modeling (PostgreSQL), transactions/consistency, and performance tuning; caching strategies.
  • Security mindset for financial systems and familiarity with regulated environments (KYC/KYB/KYT concepts).

Nice to have

  • Experience with FX & rate-locking, treasury, reconciliation at multi-entity scale.
  • Knowledge of local rails (PIX, ACH), cards, and crypto on/off-ramps.
  • Previous experience with compliance audit processes (e.g. SOC2)

How we work

title: Software Architect (Contractor) – Composable Commerce & Event-Driven Design
description:
Overview

This position is 100% remote, with flexible daily/weekly hours (part-time).

We’re looking for a Software Architect contractor with strong expertise in composable modular architecture and event-driven design to support the next evolution of Sharewise: our marketplace framework that helps entrepreneurs and small businesses launch world-class platforms faster.

This isn’t a “keep the lights on” role. You’ll be shaping the backbone of a framework designed to democratise marketplace creation and empower communities. Sharewise is built on 12+ years of CobbleWeb’s experience delivering high-performance marketplaces, and we’re now evolving it into a platform that is modular, event-driven, and future-ready.

We need someone who can:

  • Audit and strengthen module isolation (reduce hidden coupling).
  • Push us toward a stronger event-driven architecture (pub/sub over direct calls).
  • Lay the foundation for customisation: moving from fragile inheritance overrides toward clear extension hooks, composition patterns, and well-documented integration points. This is about more than code style: it’s about making Sharewise a framework where developers can confidently adapt and extend features without breaking core stability.
  • Make the platform easier to scale, extend, and maintain, both for our team and for external developers.

Stack :

  • Backend & Core: Node.js (TypeScript) - Fastify for REST, Apollo for GraphQL, TypeORM, Redis, PostgreSQL.
    Side deps: chalk, chokidar, commander, winston, class-transformer, class-validator.
  • Frontend: Next.js v15 & React v19.

title: Senior Director of Pre-Award
description:
Overview

Senior Director of Pre-Award – Incoming Awards & Account Setup at Howard University. Leads pre-award operations for all incoming sponsored awards and institutional account establishment, ensuring awards, contracts, and modifications are negotiated, accepted, and entered into institutional systems with accuracy, timeliness, and compliance to federal, sponsor, and university policies.

Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Pre-Award – Incoming Awards & Account Setup provides strategic and hands-on leadership to a team responsible for contract negotiation, award intake, amendments, prior approvals, and account establishment. The role emphasizes building structure, enforcing SOPs, training staff, and ensuring sponsor expectations are met while minimizing audit risks and delivering timely support to faculty.

Supervisory Authority

  • Directly supervises Pre-Award Research Administrators and administrative support staff.
  • Oversees negotiation and execution of incoming sponsored awards, award setup, and award modifications within the Sponsored Programs Office.
  • Provides training, mentorship, and professional development to pre-award staff.
  • Oversees faculty engagement and training on proposal development and compliance.
  • Collaborates with the Senior Director of Pre-Award (Outgoing Proposals & Subawards) to establish best practices.

Nature And Scope

  • Reports to the Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Sponsored Programs and serves as one of two senior leaders of the Pre-Award Office.
  • Provides oversight for all incoming sponsored awards and institutional account establishment, including negotiation, acceptance, amendments, and prior approvals.
  • Ensures all new awards and modifications are accurately established in Cayuse and Workday with complete documentation, budget alignment, and compliance approvals.
  • Acts as a primary point of contact for institutional negotiations with external sponsors and subrecipient institutions related to incoming awards.
  • Partners with the Senior Director of Outgoing Proposals & Subawards to align workflows and SOPs.
  • Escalates complex negotiations, compliance risks, or sponsor-related issues requiring institutional resolution.
  • Cross-trains with the Senior Director of Outgoing Proposals & Subawards to ensure continuity across the full pre-award lifecycle.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Incoming Awards & Negotiation: Lead negotiation, review, and acceptance of all incoming sponsored agreements (federal, industry, foundation, and subawards).
  • Award Setup & Account Establishment: Oversee creation and validation of award records in Cayuse and Workday; ensure timely activation of accounts for project spending.
  • Compliance & Risk: Identify high-risk terms and coordinate with Legal and university leadership.
  • Modifications: Process sponsor-driven amendments, PI/budget/scope changes, JITs, and no-cost extensions.
  • Systems & Process: Track award setup timelines and handoffs; refine SOPs; optimize use of Cayuse SP, Workday Grants, and related systems.
  • Faculty & Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate timelines and requirements clearly to faculty and department administrators; represent the university professionally in sponsor communications.
  • Strategic & Institutional Leadership: Provide data-driven insights on award volume and timelines; contribute to policy development and compliance initiatives.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership & Mentorship
  • Agreement & Contract Expertise
  • Award Setup Proficiency
  • Compliance Knowledge (2 CFR 200, FAR/DFARS)
  • Organization & Communication
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Process Orientation & Systems Proficiency
  • Change Management & Resilience

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred; extensive grant and contract administration experience.
  • 10+ years in research administration; 5+ years in leadership roles.
  • Proven ability to manage full pre-award lifecycle (negotiation, intake, amendments, setup) in research administration systems.
  • Strong understanding of federal regulations (2 CFR 200; FAR/DFARS) and sponsor-specific guidelines.
  • Experience with electronic research administration platforms (e.g., Cayuse SP, Workday Grants, Kuali Research).
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with accuracy and compliance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to engage faculty, sponsors, and internal partners.
  • Experience mentoring staff and implementing structured training and SOPs.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $163,636 - $180,000

Our partner is a company where data drives insight and architecture drives impact. They provide advanced analytics and real-time data pipelines that power the foodservice supply chain.

Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Data Architect to design and evolve scalable, high-performance data systems in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and beyond.   • Team Leader : Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills; experience leading cross-functional efforts and mentoring engineers.

Preferred Qualifications :

  • Experience with supply chain, analytics platforms, and / or foodservice data domains.
  • Background in designing self-service data platforms and data product models.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks relevant to data platforms.

Benefits :

  • The opportunity to contribute to a leading company driving data innovation in the foodservice industry.

  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

description:
Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro.A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área defisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Avaliar, incrementar e fortalecer fatores de proteção que permitam ampliação da resiliência dos pacientes e familiares frente às situações emergenciais que chegam ao Serviço de Psicologia Hospitalar através das solicitações dos integrantes da equipe de saúde

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Psicologia
  • Pós Graduação Completa em uma ou mais áreas citadas a seguir: Neuropsicologia, Psicanálise, Psicologia Humanista e Abordagem Centrada na Pessoa, Psicoterapia Cognitivo - Comportamental da Infância e Adolescência, Psicologia Clínica, Psicologia Social, Psicologia Psicomotricidade,Estratégia Saúde da Família ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Psicólogo.

Local de Trabalho: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Carga Horária: 30H (diurno e noturno) e 40H (diarista)

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Sobre a Flowa

A Flowa Technologies é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em mercado financeiro e pioneira no segmento de Electronic Trading. Desenvolvemos soluções tecnológicas robustas e eficientes voltadas para a negociação eletrônica de ativos financeiros nas principais bolsas das Américas. Atuando sob o conceito de “tecnologia como serviço”, atendemos as principais corretoras de valores, gestores de recursos e investidores institucionais do mercado. Temos o compromisso contínuo com o desenvolvimento de soluções inteligentes, ágeis e que transformem a experiência de investir, priorizando a estabilidade, velocidade e segurança para os nossos clientes. Movidos por tecnologia e inovação, sede de aprendizado contínuo e vontade de fazer a diferença, somos um time comprometido e apaixonado pelo que fazemos. Estamos atualmente envolvidos em um projeto único: a criação de uma nova bolsa de valores para o Brasil. Junto com a nossa evolução, crescem os desafios e buscamos profissionais com iniciativa, motivados e com disposição para aprender.

O que você fará

No seu dia a dia você irá :

  • Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos complexos envolvendo instituições financeiras, investidores, intermediários e demais participantes do mercado;
  • Apoiar a estruturação de produtos, serviços e parcerias sob regulamentação do BACEN e da CVM;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e preventiva, assegurando conformidade regulatória e mitigação de riscos;
  • Produzir pareceres jurídicos objetivos, claros e orientados ao negócio;
  • Prestar suporte em demandas societárias e regulatórias relacionadas à bolsa de valores;
  • Relacionar-se com stakeholders estratégicos, órgãos reguladores e escritórios externos.

O que você precisa

  • Inglês fluente (oral e escrito);
  • Experiência comprovada em contratos regulados por BACEN e/ou CVM;
  • Vivência em operações no mercado financeiro, preferencialmente em ambientes de bolsa, corretoras, bancos ou gestoras;
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara, negociação em alto nível e visão estratégica.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em contencioso civil, trabalhista e/ou tributário;
  • Histórico de atuação em ambientes regulados.

A Flowa é movimento, crescimento e evolução. Aqui você encontrará um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde todos são protagonistas. Se você busca uma oportunidade de crescimento e quer fazer parte de uma equipe engajada no propósito de transformar o mercado de electronic trading, vem com a gente!

title: Senior Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Overview

Senior Cloud Solution Architect- Automation

Location : Brazil / Argentina (Remote)

Contract

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role will interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber / Privacy / Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences

Technical Expertise :

Cloud Platform Proficiency :

  • Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.

Embedded Systems and CI / CD :

  • Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI / CD and DevSecOps practices.

Architecture Design :

  • Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP / REST) and API development.

.NET Development Skills :

  • Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.

Integration with SAP and Salesforce :

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.

Security and Compliance :

  • Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.

Scalability and High Availability :

  • Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.

Agile Development Practices :

  • Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.

Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking :

  • Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills : Prototyping :

  • Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.

Vendor and Partner Engagement :

  • Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.

Cloud Architecture Design :

  • Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others

  • Agile Collaboration : Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting : Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration : Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

Estamos presentes em todo território nacional, ofertando cursos de graduação, pós-graduação e cursos livres, nas modalidades presencial e digital, e nossa busca constante pela qualidade acadêmica e investimentos na área de ensino garantem que as nossas instituições e cursos sejam reconhecidos pelo MEC com elevados conceitos de qualidade.

Sempre nos dedicamos a lapidar talentos para revelar a vocação de cada estudante. Os alunos também sabem que nós reconhecemos, em cada um, um diamante a ser polido. Juntos, formamos uma comunidade de diferentes perfis e sonhos, presente em todos os cantos do Brasil. VISÃO

Entregar a melhor experiência de aprendizagem a cada vez mais alunos com eficiência, uso intensivo de tecnologia e qualidade acadêmica em cada uma das nossas marcas, possibilitando um salto nas opções de vida do egresso.

Fazemos o certo, valorizamos as diferenças e a diversidade.

Contamos com profissionais que valorizam a inovação em um ambiente diverso, com simplicidade e ética. Nossas iniciativas sempre têm o aluno no centro da decisão , pois consideramos o seu sucessocomo nosso.

title: Project Accountant
description:
Overview

The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires technical project accounting expertise and strong communication and collaboration skills to work with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Control & Compliance
    • Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.
    • Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.
    • Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
    • Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts.
    • Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.
    • Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.
    • Prepare and monitor hedge calculations, manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.
    • Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.
    • Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.
    • Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules.
    • Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.
    • Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.
    • Support the analysis of new bids and tenders, with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.
    • Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.

Key Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.
  • Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.
  • Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.
  • Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.
  • Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.
  • Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.
  • Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality.
  • Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

Culture & fit

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less — and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by our core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better everyday. We love learning — every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn’t it. If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders and play a big role in scaling it to $12M+ a year, drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking people, and you’re excited by growth, you’ve come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting to final creative) to produce high-converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content for all marketing channels.
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC direct response creatives.
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve creatives for ongoing performance gains.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to optimize creative efforts.
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Decide on next steps to scale Meta Ads through better creative.

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise: 3+ years experience with performance creative for DTC brands or at a creative agency.
  • Tools & Metrics: Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience: Experience creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high-converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot lists, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • Willingness to work overtime or weekends if needed, and a strong work ethic.
  • Excellent cultural fit with our values.
  • Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms.
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis.
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team.
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets for better ROI.

Cuidando de você, sempre!
Somos a Drogaria Venancio, uma marca carioca que, há mais de 45 anos, coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. title: ENFERMEIRO GENERALISTA - CENTRO OBSTÉTRICO - MATERNIDADE MARIA AMÉLIA BUARQUE DE HOLLANDA
description:
Job description

O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistências estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada.

Inaugurada em 2012 a Maternidade oferta atividades assistenciais nas 24 horas do dia, todos os dias da semana, inclusive sábados, domingos e feriados.

O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.

Main responsibilities

  • Organizar a operacionalização do serviço de Enfermagem e garantir o bom andamento dos serviços; realizar orientações aos pacientes; manter controle de salas equipamentos e leitos disponíveis; orientar o trabalho da equipe de técnicos;
  • Atender as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);
  • Garantir o cumprimento das rotinas, normas e protocolos institucionais e de SMS;
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao usuário, desde a sua admissão, e acompanhar o atendimento técnico;
  • Atuar como facilitador de todos os processos que envolvem o atendimento de enfermagem;
  • Promover, juntamente ao gestor, ambiente que proporcione melhorias contínuas no processo assistencial;
  • Manter a comunicação com o corpo clínico, referente a mudanças no fluxo da Assistência de Enfermagem (quando interferir em processo médico);
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem segura, humanizada e individualizada aos pacientes;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas junto aos serviços de saúde colaborando para o controle de infecção;
  • Ministrar treinamentos quando necessário promovendo atualização contínua à equipe de enfermagem;
  • Auxiliar o gestor no controle de certificação profissional da equipe de enfermagem junto ao conselho de classe, assim como executar o processo de comunicação junto órgão;
  • Conduzir a gestão das notificações de não conformidades de avaliação de eficácia, referentes à Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Gerir o controle de entrada e saída de materiais estocados no setor, mantendo o estoque mínimo necessário para o desenvolvimento da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Preencher e supervisionar o preenchimento dos registros específicos da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Assegurar a correta utilização dos equipamentos e acessórios disponíveis para o processo assistencial;
  • Prestar assistência a pacientes graves, desde a admissão, e acompanhá-los em caso de remoção á outro serviço;
  • Organizar processo de armazenamento de receituários controlados;
  • Organizar e controlar processo de esterilização de materiais;
  • Supervisionar ou acompanhar a realização de procedimentos assistenciais, enfocando segurança e diminuição de riscos de infecção;

title: Fund Accountant, Implementations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

Awards and Acknowledgements

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies, Fast Company\u2019s Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies. We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S., a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work.

Interested in data privacy? Check out our policies on Privacy and CA Candidate Privacy.

Faça parceria com os melhores:

O Técnico Teste será responsável pela avaliação do estado dos equipamentos de testes, organizando os equipamentos disponíveis para as atividades de montagem seja para testes de pequena, média e grande escala nos laboratórios da planta, como também, trabalhando em conjunto com o time de planejamento e engenharia de testes.

Como Técnico de Teste , você será responsável por:

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e aplicação de ferramentas para adequação da estrutura de testes existentes, dando suporte operacional nas áreas de hidráulica, elétrica, eletrotécnica e mecânica
  • Responsável pelas instalações de teste, bancadas de teste, sistemas de instrumentação e teste de comissionamento de testes e bancadas e, na operação e inspeção de vasos de pressão.
  • Atuar em atividades que exijam trabalho em altura, espaço confinado e no içamento de cargas quando aplicável.
  • Comprometimento com a qualidade das atividades desempenhadas com o levantamento de medições de produtividade e engajamento com as políticas de qualidade internas para alcançar o grau de qualidade exigida pelos nossos clientes
  • Execução de testes laboratoriais, montagem e instrumentação de vasos de pressão.
  • Realizar testes hidrostáticos em vasos de pressão e em sistemas hidráulicos;
  • Realizar a instrumentação dos vasos de pressão;
  • Dimensionamento e seleção de transdutores de pressão, válvulas de alívio de pressão, sensores de temperatura tipo PT-100.
  • Execução de instrumentação e instalações hidráulicas e pneumáticas (ex.: dobra de tubing e instalação de conexões 1/4’’ NPT, 1/4” OD, válvula esfera e agulha).
  • Trabalhar e assegurar a conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da empresa relativos à Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, assegurando que sejam praticados por seus colaboradores, reportando qualquer não-conformidade, acidente, incidente ou potenciais situações de risco e interrompendo eventuais situações inseguras ou prejudiciais ao meio ambiente, à saúde e à segurança, baseado em atitude, treinamento, liderança e comprometimento.

Alimente sua paixão

Para ter sucesso nesta função, você precisa:

  • Ensino Técnico de Nível Médio em Mecânica, eletrotécnica, elétrica, eletrônica ou Metalurgia completo
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe (CRT) – mandatório
  • Inglês técnico básico desejável (leitura e interpretação de desenhos e normas técnicas)
  • Desejável experiência em materiais metálicos e poliméricos

Job Summary

Howard University seeks an Accounting Analyst to support financial operations by performing various tasks related to third-party payments and reconciliations, financial aid, and accounting processes. This position ensures compliance with federal, state, and institutional regulations while delivering excellent customer service.

Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent customer service to students, staff, and external partners in cashiering, billing, collections, and loans.

  • Attend meetings with Treasury Services, General Accounting, and other departments to ensure accurate financial processing and resolve reconciliation issues.
  • Assist in developing and revising accounting policies and procedures related to reconciliation, cash handling, and financial reporting.

  • Proficiency with automated financial systems and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Expertise in financial reconciliation processes, ensuring accuracy in balancing accounts and resolving discrepancies.
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team, managing multiple high-priority tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Knowledge of general accounting principles, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, and reconciliation best practices.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to manage confidential financial information discreetly.
  • Ability to meet deadlines and work effectively under pressure.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field. At least five years of progressive accounting-related experience, including reconciliation responsibilities or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in a related field. Experience with financial systems such as Banner, Argos, Touchnet, and Workday. Knowledge of external invoicing systems such as WAWF, AFIT, and government purchase orders.

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

Nossa cultura é um grande diferencial!

Main responsibilities

Objetivo do Cargo

A posição de Especialista Tributário tem como objetivo liderar tecnicamente as estratégias de compliance e defesa tributária da empresa, com foco em tributos federais diretos (especialmente IRPJ e CSLL), atuando de forma proativa na gestão de riscos, na condução de processos de contencioso administrativo, interpretação e normatização de legislação federal e na identificação de oportunidades fiscais.   • Participar de comitês internos e reuniões estratégicas com áreas como Jurídico, Contabilidade, Planejamento Financeiro e Negócios e correlatas.

title: Demand Manager Brazil
description:
Overview

Demand Manager Brazil – Haleon

Lead the process of generation and market sign-off on the most reliable forecast for all products in the market or markets under responsibility, coordinating cross-functional inputs to drive decisions on volumes based on quality data analysis. Provide visibility to improve supply and financial planning processes to optimize inventory, avoid write-offs, and improve customer service. The role is a key stakeholder for the General Manager and Leadership Team in the market(s) represented.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the process of generating an unconstrained and constrained forecast on a monthly basis (core activity in the IBP process).
  • Enable monthly validation of business performance and support decisions to achieve commercial objectives integrated with finance by identifying, analyzing, and defining actions to cover risks or gaps against the Plan.
  • Manage end-to-end demand forecasting across all brands to improve forecast accuracy and enhance customer service levels in line with external benchmarks.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver sales gap closing opportunities as required.
  • Define key forecasting roles and accountabilities across the business to align Sales, Marketing, Trade and Finance and drive a one-number mindset for decision making and forecast transparency.
  • Act as unbiased and neutral Business Partner to the General Manager and LT.
  • Establish and embed revised Demand Forecasting processes to support the Supply Chain Operating Model and Core Commercial Cycle.
  • Establish processes to support key account and trade channel-specific forecast capability to drive service levels and reduce working capital requirements.
  • Manage Demand Forecasting input into key IBP meetings (Demand Review, Supply Review, regional S&OP).
  • Identify and understand forecast changes across short- and long-term horizons to support supply chain action and informed decision making.
  • Ensure seamless handover of demand forecast and market intelligence to supply planning hubs to optimize inventory levels.
  • Integrate Trade Spend/Net Sales inputs to prioritize cost-effective net sales delivery.
  • Lead or contribute to significant projects to transform the operating model, including gross-to-net, complexity reduction, COGs, and working capital improvements.
  • Develop technical and IT capabilities to support baseline statistical modeling and integration of forecast platforms for improved accuracy.
  • Deliver long-range volume forecasts for plan submission and mid-year review.
  • Internally measure and report demand forecasting KPIs to drive improvements in forecast accuracy, bias, working capital, and customer service.
  • Provide a consolidated view of forecast trends and robustness across all Trade Channels/Categories.
  • Lead Brand/Category and Channel forecast input into Demand Review Meetings; challenge Sales/Marketing inputs to align volume and value forecasts across business units.
  • Collaborate with Category & Shopper/Sales and Marketing teams to validate NPI forecasts and assumptions.
  • Recruit and develop talent to support best-in-class forecast capability and performance.
  • Incorporate Sample and Promotional Packs inputs as required; maintain detailed knowledge of all forecast components (statistical baseline, promotions, cannibalization, market intelligence, NPI).
  • Monitor key trends impacting market, sector, and category performance.
  • Support and ensure QMS-compliant processes are in place and followed; promote a safe and compliant working environment.

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
Join to apply for the Billing Analyst I role at Airswift

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

It\'s a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift\'s sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and timely manner between Airswift\'s legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.

title: Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager (Remote)
description:
Overview

MonetizeMore is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization:
    • Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms (Meta, Google, DSPs, etc.).
    • Manage budgets, bids, and targeting strategies to maximize campaign performance.
    • Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, and funnel optimization.
  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:
    • Oversee ad trafficking, tag implementation (Google Tag Manager, pixels, etc.), and QA.
    • Troubleshoot discrepancies in delivery, tracking, or attribution.
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting:
    • Monitor KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and provide actionable insights.
    • Generate reports and present findings to stakeholders.
    • Ensure alignment between media spend and business objectives.
  • Client & Stakeholder Success:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices.
    • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Technical Proficiency - Familiarity with digital advertising tools and platforms like Google Ad Manager, WordPress, GAM 360, traffic acquisition tools such as Active Campaign and header bidding solutions.
  • Problem-Solving Skills - Resourceful in identifying issues, troubleshooting errors, and finding effective solutions.
  • Attention to Detail - Precision in setting up campaigns, implementing ad tags, or managing publisher configurations to ensure optimal outcomes.
  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding.
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction.
  • Knowledge of Ad Metrics - Understanding of key ad metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, RPM, and ad yield optimization strategies.
  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance.
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers.
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business.
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude.
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively.
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, data enrichment tools, automated workflows) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance.

If you think you are a good fit to join the MonetizeMore team, please fill out the application. Also, give specific reasons on what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality ;)

The Coordinator, Team Services will support organizing internal operations and administrative matters within the Team Services department at the FIFA27 office in Rio de Janeiro.

The key requirements will be to establish and maintain efficient working relationships within the department and across other functional areas, proactive communication and the sharing of information, systematic work processes, diligent record keeping, and any other administrative support required by Team Services colleagues.

  • Supporting the preparation and implementation of readiness exercises (simulation exercises) at Team Base Camp Hotels at Team Base Camp Training Sites with all member associations involved;
  • Contribute to and support the preparation of maps and drawings for team and referee training sites and hotels (including security perimeters, parking allocation, media facilities, etc.);

  • Able to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain experienced and less experienced employees.
  • Able to understand and adapt to new information quickly, and comfortable with learning new systems.
  • High energy levels, strong negotiation and facilitation skills, excellent communication and presentation skills and positive relationship management abilities.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams), Smartsheet and other planning tools.
